use project_game_sdk::generated_content::*;
use project_game_sdk::physics_query3d::PhysicsQuery3D;
use project_game_sdk::*;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::sync::{
    atomic::{AtomicUsize, Ordering},
    mpsc,
};

static STARTED: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);
static JOINED: AtomicUsize = AtomicUsize::new(0);

// Test-project instrumentation, not an Engine ABI extension.
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn generated_content_376_worker_counts() -> u64 {
    ((STARTED.load(Ordering::SeqCst) as u64) << 32) | JOINED.load(Ordering::SeqCst) as u64
}

pub struct Session {
    worker: Option<std::thread::JoinHandle<()>>,
    stop: mpsc::Sender<()>,
    data: std::sync::Mutex<mpsc::Receiver<Vec<[f32; 3]>>>,
    stage: u8,
    storage: u8,
    since: u64,
    applied: u64,
    collision: u64,
    epoch: u64,
    applied_tick: u64,
    moved_tick: u64,
    persisted: bool,
    reloaded: bool,
    ray_checks: u64,
}
impl ProjectGameSession for Session {
    fn session_id(&self) -> &str {
        "376.ordinary-project"
    }
}
impl Drop for Session {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let _ = self.stop.send(());
        self.worker
            .take()
            .unwrap()
            .join()
            .expect("project worker must join before destroy_session returns");
        JOINED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        assert_eq!(
            JOINED.load(Ordering::SeqCst),
            STARTED.load(Ordering::SeqCst)
        );
        eprintln!("376-WORKER joined-before-destroy-return");
    }
}
pub fn project_game() -> ProjectGameDefinition<Session> {
    ProjectGameDefinition::new(|_: &SessionCreateRequest| {
        assert_eq!(
            STARTED.load(Ordering::SeqCst),
            JOINED.load(Ordering::SeqCst)
        );
        let (send, data) = mpsc::channel();
        let (stop, recv) = mpsc::channel();
        STARTED.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
        let worker = std::thread::spawn(move || {
            send.send(vec![[-0.7, -0.7, 0.], [0.7, -0.7, 0.], [0., 0.7, 0.]])
                .unwrap();
            let _ = recv.recv();
        });
        Ok(Session {
            worker: Some(worker),
            stop,
            data: std::sync::Mutex::new(data),
            stage: 0,
            storage: 0,
            since: 0,
            applied: 0,
            collision: 0,
            epoch: 0,
            applied_tick: 0,
            moved_tick: 0,
            persisted: false,
            reloaded: false,
            ray_checks: 0,
        })
    })
    .fixed_update(step)
    .observe(observe)
    .generated_content()
    .project_storage()
}
fn content_error(error: ContentError) -> GameError {
    GameError::new(GameErrorCode::Failed, error.to_string())
}
fn bytes() -> Vec<u8> {
    (0..6000).map(|i| (i % 251) as u8).collect()
}
fn mesh(vertices: &[[f32; 3]], color: [f32; 4]) -> Geometry3D {
    let indices: &[u16] = if vertices.len() == 3 {
        &[0, 1, 2]
    } else {
        &[0, 1, 2, 0, 2, 3]
    };
    GeometryBuilder3D::new(vertices)
        .colors(&vec![color; vertices.len()])
        .triangles_u16(
            indices,
            vec![GeometrySection3D {
                first_index: 0,
                index_count: indices.len() as u32,
                material_slot: "surface".into(),
                material: SpatialAssetRef {
                    id: "surface-material".into(),
                    asset_type: "material".into(),
                    guid: Some("376-material".into()),
                    sub_asset: None,
                },
            }],
        )
        .unwrap()
}
fn body(vertices: &[[f32; 3]]) -> CollisionUpdate3D {
    let triangles: &[[u32; 3]] = if vertices.len() == 3 {
        &[[0, 1, 2]]
    } else {
        &[[0, 1, 2], [0, 2, 3]]
    };
    CollisionUpdate3D::Replace {
        body: StaticBody3D::new(StaticShape3D::triangles(vertices, triangles).unwrap()),
    }
}
fn target(ctx: &GameCallContext<'_>) -> GameResult<EntityHandle> {
    ctx.world().resolve_entity("surface")
}
fn check_rays(s: &mut Session, ctx: &GameCallContext<'_>, expected: [bool; 2]) -> GameResult<()> {
    let result = ctx.world().physics_query3d(&[
        PhysicsQuery3D::Raycast {
            origin: [0., 0., 0.],
            displacement: [0., 0., -10.],
        },
        PhysicsQuery3D::Raycast {
            origin: [2., 0., 0.],
            displacement: [0., 0., -10.],
        },
    ])?;
    assert!(
        result.tick.is_some(),
        "new static state must be consumed by a real solver step"
    );
    assert_eq!(
        result
            .hits
            .iter()
            .map(|h| h.as_ref().is_some_and(|h| h.entity == "surface"))
            .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
        expected
    );
    s.ray_checks += 1;
    Ok(())
}
fn storage(s: &mut Session, ctx: &mut GameCallContext<'_>) -> GameResult<()> {
    if s.storage == 0 {
        ctx.mutations().read_project_bytes(1, "parameters")?;
        s.storage = 1;
        return Ok(());
    }
    if s.storage == 4 {
        return Ok(());
    }
    let id = match s.storage {
        1 => 1,
        2 => 2,
        _ => 3,
    };
    let receipt = ctx
        .world()
        .query_project_storage(StorageQuery::Request { request_id: id })?
        .map_err(content_error)?;
    if !receipt.status.terminal() {
        return Ok(());
    }
    if s.storage == 1
        && receipt
            .error
            .as_ref()
            .is_some_and(|e| e.code == ContentErrorCode::NotFound)
    {
        ctx.mutations()
            .write_project_bytes(2, "parameters", bytes())?;
        s.storage = 2;
    } else if s.storage == 2 {
        assert_eq!(receipt.commit_state, StorageCommitState::Committed);
        assert!(receipt.error.is_none());
        ctx.mutations().read_project_bytes(3, "parameters")?;
        s.storage = 3;
    } else {
        let result = ctx
            .world()
            .take_project_bytes(receipt.ticket)?
            .map_err(content_error)?;
        assert_eq!(
            result.bytes,
            bytes(),
            "real DLL binary read reply must preserve all 6000 bytes"
        );
        s.reloaded = s.storage == 1;
        s.persisted = true;
        s.storage = 4;
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn step(
    s: &mut Session,
    ctx: &mut GameCallContext<'_>,
    r: &FrameRequest,
) -> GameResult<SessionOutput> {
    storage(s, ctx)?;
    let tick = r.time.fixed_frame_count;
    if s.stage == 0 {
        if let Ok(vertices) = s.data.lock().unwrap().try_recv() {
            let entity = target(ctx)?;
            // Both builders own their bytes; the project arrays are freed on return.
            ctx.mutations().replace_geometry3d(
                &entity,
                1,
                0,
                mesh(&vertices, [1., 0., 0., 1.]),
                body(&vertices),
            )?;
            s.stage = 1;
        }
    } else if s.stage < 11 {
        let request = match s.stage {
            1 | 2 => 1,
            3 | 4 => 2,
            5 | 6 => 3,
            7 | 8 => 4,
            _ => 5,
        };
        let ContentQueryValue::Receipt { receipt } = ctx
            .world()
            .query_generated_content(ContentQuery::Request {
                request_id: request,
            })?
            .map_err(content_error)?
        else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        assert!(receipt.error.is_none(), "{receipt:?}");
        if receipt.status == ContentStatus::Applied {
            s.applied = receipt.applied_revision;
            s.collision = receipt.collision_revision;
            s.epoch = receipt.commit_epoch.unwrap();
            if matches!(s.stage, 1 | 3 | 5 | 7 | 9) {
                eprintln!(
                    "376-APPLIED request={} revision={} collision={} epoch={} simulation_tick={}",
                    request, s.applied, s.collision, s.epoch, tick
                );
            }
            match s.stage {
                1 => {
                    check_rays(s, ctx, [true, false])?;
                    s.applied_tick = tick;
                    s.since = tick;
                    s.stage = 2;
                }
                2 if tick >= s.since + 40 => {
                    let entity = target(ctx)?;
                    let vertices = vec![
                        [1.3, -0.7, 0.],
                        [2.7, -0.7, 0.],
                        [2.7, 0.7, 0.],
                        [1.3, 0.7, 0.],
                    ];
                    ctx.mutations().replace_geometry3d(
                        &entity,
                        2,
                        s.applied,
                        mesh(&vertices, [0., 0., 1., 1.]),
                        body(&vertices),
                    )?;
                    s.stage = 3;
                }
                3 => {
                    check_rays(s, ctx, [false, true])?;
                    s.moved_tick = tick;
                    s.since = tick;
                    s.stage = 4;
                }
                4 if tick >= s.since + 40 => {
                    let entity = target(ctx)?;
                    ctx.mutations().update_geometry_attributes3d(
                        &entity,
                        3,
                        s.applied,
                        AttributePatch3D::colors(0, &[[0., 1., 0., 1.]; 4]).unwrap(),
                    )?;
                    s.stage = 5;
                }
                5 => {
                    assert_eq!(s.collision, 2);
                    check_rays(s, ctx, [false, true])?;
                    s.since = tick;
                    s.stage = 6;
                }
                6 if tick >= s.since + 40 => {
                    let entity = target(ctx)?;
                    ctx.mutations().update_geometry_attributes3d(
                        &entity,
                        4,
                        s.applied,
                        AttributePatch3D::positions(
                            0,
                            &[
                                [-2.7, -0.7, 0.],
                                [-1.3, -0.7, 0.],
                                [-1.3, 0.7, 0.],
                                [-2.7, 0.7, 0.],
                            ],
                        )
                        .unwrap(),
                    )?;
                    s.stage = 7;
                }
                7 => {
                    assert_eq!(
                        s.collision, 2,
                        "visual position patch keeps the prior static shape"
                    );
                    check_rays(s, ctx, [false, true])?;
                    s.since = tick;
                    s.stage = 8;
                }
                8 if tick >= s.since + 40 => {
                    let entity = target(ctx)?;
                    ctx.mutations().replace_collision3d(
                        &entity,
                        5,
                        s.applied,
                        CollisionUpdate3D::Replace {
                            body: StaticBody3D::new(StaticShape3D::Box {
                                half_extents: [0.7, 0.7, 0.2],
                            }),
                        },
                    )?;
                    s.stage = 9;
                }
                9 => {
                    assert_eq!(s.collision, 5);
                    check_rays(s, ctx, [true, false])?;
                    s.since = tick;
                    s.stage = 10;
                }
                10 if tick >= s.since + 40 => {
                    // Valid wire payload, stale revision: admission must preserve current visual/collision.
                    let entity = target(ctx)?;
                    ctx.mutations()
                        .release_generated_geometry3d(&entity, 6, 0)?;
                    s.stage = 11;
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
    } else if s.stage == 11 {
        let ContentQueryValue::Receipt { receipt } = ctx
            .world()
            .query_generated_content(ContentQuery::Request { request_id: 5 })?
            .map_err(content_error)?
        else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        let ContentQueryValue::Target { state } = ctx
            .world()
            .query_generated_content(ContentQuery::Target {
                target: receipt.target,
            })?
            .map_err(content_error)?
        else {
            unreachable!()
        };
        assert_eq!(
            (
                state.applied_revision,
                state.collision_revision,
                state.pending_revision
            ),
            (5, 5, None)
        );
        check_rays(s, ctx, [true, false])?;
        s.stage = 12;
    }
    let mut output = SessionOutput::no_op();
    output.status = HandlerStatus::Applied;
    Ok(output)
}
fn observe(
    s: &mut Session,
    _: &mut GameCallContext<'_>,
    r: &FrameRequest,
) -> GameResult<ObservationOutput> {
    let mut values = BTreeMap::new();
    for (key, value) in [
        ("stage", u64::from(s.stage)),
        ("applied", s.applied),
        ("collision", s.collision),
        ("epoch", s.epoch),
        ("tick", r.time.fixed_frame_count),
        ("appliedTick", s.applied_tick),
        ("movedTick", s.moved_tick),
        ("rayChecks", s.ray_checks),
    ] {
        values.insert(format!("content.{key}"), Value::Integer(value as i64));
    }
    values.insert("content.persisted".into(), Value::Bool(s.persisted));
    values.insert("content.reloaded".into(), Value::Bool(s.reloaded));
    Ok(ObservationOutput { values })
}
